# observe_monitor (Resource)

A website monitor. Every check type (uptime, SSL, heartbeat, crawl, Lighthouse, sitemap, robots.txt, domain, DNS records, DNS blocklists, reverse monitor, status page) is set with the API's field names, e.g. `uptime_interval_minutes`, `crawl_monitoring_enabled`. Settings you leave out keep the values Observe gives them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "observe_monitor" "shop" {
  url   = "https://shop.example.com"
  label = "Shop"
  tags  = ["shop", "eu"]

  # Uptime
  uptime_interval_minutes     = 1
  uptime_expected_codes       = "200"
  uptime_check_string         = "Add to cart"
  uptime_alert_after_failures = 2
  uptime_check_headers        = jsonencode({ Accept = "text/html" })
  uptime_regions              = ["us-east", "ap-southeast"]

  # Certificate and domain expiry
  ssl_expiring_soon_days    = 14
  domain_monitoring_enabled = true

  # Crawl for broken links and mixed content, weekly
  crawl_monitoring_enabled = true
  crawl_max_pages          = 2000
  crawl_interval_minutes   = 10080
  crawl_ignore_patterns    = ["/admin/*", "/cart"]

  # Lighthouse
  lighthouse_monitoring_enabled = true
  lighthouse_strategy           = "both"
  lighthouse_thresholds         = { min_score = 80, max_lcp_ms = 2500 }
}

# A cron heartbeat: ping heartbeat_ping_url from the job.
resource "observe_monitor" "nightly_backup" {
  url                       = "https://shop.example.com/backup"
  uptime_monitoring_enabled = false
  ssl_monitoring_enabled    = false
  heartbeat_enabled         = true
  heartbeat_cron_expression = "0 3 * * *"
  heartbeat_timezone        = "Europe/London"
  heartbeat_grace_minutes   = 15
}

output "backup_ping_url" {
  value = observe_monitor.nightly_backup.heartbeat_ping_url
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String)

### Optional

- `crawl_alert_on_broken` (Boolean) Crawl
- `crawl_alert_on_console_errors` (Boolean) Crawl
- `crawl_alert_on_lighthouse_regression` (Boolean) Crawl
- `crawl_alert_on_mixed_content` (Boolean) Crawl
- `crawl_alert_on_screenshot_diff` (Boolean) Crawl
- `crawl_check_external_links` (Boolean) Crawl
- `crawl_ignore_patterns` (List of String) Crawl: URL patterns to skip, e.g. ["/admin/*"] (or one per line), up to 100
- `crawl_interval_minutes` (Number) Crawl
- `crawl_lighthouse_regression_threshold` (Number) Crawl
- `crawl_max_depth` (Number) Crawl
- `crawl_max_pages` (Number) Crawl
- `crawl_monitoring_enabled` (Boolean) Crawl
- `crawl_request_headers` (String, Sensitive) Headers the crawler sends, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer …"}. Objects are stored as sent; a string must be JSON. JSON: use `jsonencode()`.
- `crawl_respect_robots_txt` (Boolean) Crawl
- `crawl_screenshot_diff_threshold_pct` (Number) Crawl
- `crawl_seed_from_sitemap` (Boolean) Crawl
- `crawl_time_limit_minutes` (Number) Crawl: stop after this many minutes
- `critical` (Boolean) Down alerts skip quiet hours
- `depends_on_site_id` (String) Uptime
- `dns_blocklist_check_mail` (Boolean) DNS blocklist: also check the domain's own MX servers and SPF ip4:/ip6: addresses
- `dns_blocklist_extra_targets` (List of String) DNS blocklist: extra domains or IP addresses to check (or one per line), up to 10
- `dns_blocklist_interval_minutes` (Number) DNS blocklist: minutes between checks (360, 720 or 1440); null is 1440. One of `360`, `720`, `1440`.
- `dns_blocklist_lists` (List of String) DNS blocklist: the lists to check; null is the default set
- `dns_blocklist_monitoring_enabled` (Boolean) DNS blocklist
- `dns_record_alert_types` (List of String) DNS records
- `dns_record_expectations` (String) DNS records
- `dns_record_hosts` (List of String) DNS records (a list, or one per line)
- `dns_record_ignore_patterns` (List of String) DNS records (a list, or one per line)
- `dns_record_interval_minutes` (Number) DNS records
- `dns_record_monitoring_enabled` (Boolean) DNS records
- `domain_alert_on_registration_change` (Boolean) Domain
- `domain_expiring_soon_days` (Number) Domain
- `domain_monitoring_enabled` (Boolean) Domain
- `dply_sleep_aware` (Boolean) Uptime
- `dply_wake_check_minutes` (Number) Uptime
- `heartbeat_cron_expression` (String) Heartbeat
- `heartbeat_enabled` (Boolean) Heartbeat
- `heartbeat_grace_minutes` (Number) Heartbeat
- `heartbeat_interval_minutes` (Number) Heartbeat
- `heartbeat_timezone` (String) Heartbeat: IANA timezone
- `label` (String)
- `lighthouse_monitoring_enabled` (Boolean) Lighthouse
- `lighthouse_strategy` (String) Lighthouse. One of `mobile`, `desktop`, `both`.
- `lighthouse_thresholds` (Attributes) Lighthouse thresholds; keys you leave out keep their values (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--lighthouse_thresholds))
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID; defaults to the provider's `organization_id`
- `reverse_monitor_host` (String) Reverse monitor
- `reverse_monitor_port` (Number) Reverse monitor
- `reverse_monitoring_enabled` (Boolean) Reverse monitor
- `robots_txt_interval_minutes` (Number) Robots.txt. One of `60`, `360`, `720`, `1440`.
- `robots_txt_monitoring_enabled` (Boolean) Robots.txt
- `robots_txt_watched_paths` (List of String) Robots.txt (a list, or one per line)
- `sitemap_alert_after_failures` (Number) Sitemap: failing runs in a row before alerting (default 2)
- `sitemap_alert_drop_pct` (Number) Sitemap: percent drop in listed URLs that counts as a change (default 20)
- `sitemap_alert_on_change` (Boolean) Sitemap: alert when listed URLs drop past sitemap_alert_drop_pct, the sitemap moves, or a sitemap file disappears
- `sitemap_check_indexability` (Boolean) Sitemap: load each page to flag noindex and canonical links that point elsewhere (default true)
- `sitemap_ignore_patterns` (List of String) Sitemap: URL patterns to leave unchecked, e.g. ["/tag/*"] (or one per line), up to 100
- `sitemap_interval_minutes` (Number) Sitemap: minutes between checks: 60, 360, 720, 1440 (default) or 10080. One of `60`, `360`, `720`, `1440`, `10080`.
- `sitemap_max_urls` (Number) Sitemap: URLs checked per run (default 500); a longer sitemap is checked in turns
- `sitemap_monitoring_enabled` (Boolean) Sitemap
- `sitemap_urls` (List of String) Sitemap: up to 10 sitemap URLs to check (or one per line); empty finds them from robots.txt and the usual locations
- `ssl_alert_on_every_change` (Boolean) SSL
- `ssl_ct_monitoring_enabled` (Boolean) SSL
- `ssl_expiring_soon_days` (Number) SSL
- `ssl_extra_hostnames` (List of String) SSL (a list, or one per line)
- `ssl_interval_minutes` (Number) SSL
- `ssl_monitoring_enabled` (Boolean) SSL
- `status_page_enabled` (Boolean) Status page
- `status_page_message` (String) Status page
- `status_page_show` (List of String) Status page
- `status_page_title` (String) Status page
- `status_slug` (String) Status page
- `tags` (List of String)
- `team_id` (String)
- `uptime_alert_after_failures` (Number) Uptime
- `uptime_alert_after_minutes` (Number) Uptime
- `uptime_check_absent_string` (String) Uptime
- `uptime_check_body` (String, Sensitive) Uptime
- `uptime_check_header_patterns` (String, Sensitive) Response headers that must match, a regex or substring, e.g. [{"header": "Content-Type", "pattern": "text/html"}]. Objects are stored as sent; a string must be JSON. JSON: use `jsonencode()`.
- `uptime_check_headers` (String, Sensitive) Request headers, e.g. {"Accept": "text/html"}. Objects are stored as sent; a string must be JSON. JSON: use `jsonencode()`.
- `uptime_check_json_assertions` (String, Sensitive) JSON response assertions (dot paths), e.g. [{"path": "status", "expected": "ok"}]. Objects are stored as sent; a string must be JSON. JSON: use `jsonencode()`.
- `uptime_check_method` (String) Uptime. One of `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`.
- `uptime_check_string` (String) Uptime
- `uptime_expected_codes` (String) Uptime
- `uptime_interval_minutes` (Number) Uptime
- `uptime_max_redirects` (Number) Uptime
- `uptime_monitoring_enabled` (Boolean) Uptime
- `uptime_regions` (List of String) Uptime
- `uptime_response_time_alert_after_checks` (Number) Uptime
- `uptime_response_time_threshold_ms` (Number) Uptime
- `uptime_response_time_variance_pct` (Number) Uptime
- `uptime_sla_target_percent` (Number) Uptime
- `uptime_thirty_seconds` (Boolean) Uptime
- `uptime_timeout_seconds` (Number) Uptime

### Read-Only

- `heartbeat_ping_url` (String) Ping it from your job while the heartbeat is on; append /starting or /failed
- `id` (String) ID
- `status_page_url` (String) The monitor's own status page, when it is on

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import observe_monitor.shop 01JCX5A2B3C4D5E6F7G8H9J0K1
```
